title: Two hour call

beats.say: Papa's on a video call with the CBI. Two hours. They want money moved.

screen.title: Mum
screen.body: Beta Papa 2 ghante se CBI wale video call pe hain. Bol rahe safe account mein paise daalo??

beats.say: I'm so sorry. First, how is Papa feeling?
I checked! The badge number is real!
Fake. Hang up. Call nineteen thirty.

screen.title: Digital arrest? Read this
screen.body:
1. There is no 'digital arrest'. Police never arrest on a video call.
2. Never move money on a call. There is no 'safe account'.
3. Hang up. Call 1930 or report at cybercrime.gov.in

beats.say: Like a doctor won't operate over video, police won't arrest over video. Or ask for money.

screen.title: Mum
screen.body:
Beta Papa 2 ghante se CBI wale video call pe hain. Bol rahe safe account mein paise daalo??

Papa ne phone kaat diya.
Bol rahe main to time pass kar raha tha

beats.say: Papa says he was just passing time.

caption:
papa spent 2 hours on a video call with "cbi officers" who wanted his money in a safe account.

there is no such thing as a digital arrest, and real police never ask you to move money on a call.
hang up, then call 1930 or report it at cybercrime.gov.in.
